newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid cargo tonnage up 11.5 percent in June.
newsitem.headline: Madrid cargo tonnage up 11.5 percent in June.

text.p: Cargo traffic at Madrid's Barajas airport rose 11.5 percent to 21,602 tonnes in June as strong scheduled traffic again made up for a fall in charter cargo, the airport authority said.

Domestic traffic was 22.2 percent higher at 7,087 tonnes while international traffic grew 7.0 percent to 14,715 tonnes. Scheduled freight business was 17.1 percent higher in the month at 20,459 tonnes and charter business fell 35.6 percent to account for only 1,343 tonnes of the total.
Barajas handled 132,459 tonnes of cargo in the first six months of this year, 11.4 percent more than the same period 1996.
Domestic freight has risen 16.8 percent in the year to date to 41,718 tonnes while international cargo is 9.1 percent ahead of last year at 90,741 tonnes.

Passenger numbers rose 6.3 percent in June to 1.996 million, or 11.307 million in the six month period, an increase of 10.0 percent. The number of air transport movements increased 5.7 percent to 21,671 in the month, taking the accumulated total to 128,227. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
